beats.say: If you want to copy me on eToro, this is how you find me: search Alejandro Garcia O, as one word, and check that it is this photo.
One. Create your eToro account and verify your identity.
beats.show: 1. Create your eToro account and verify your identity.

beats.say: Two. Deposit funds, or practise first in the virtual account.
beats.show: 2. Deposit funds, or practise first in the virtual account.

beats.say: Three. Search Alejandro Garcia O, and check the username and the photo.
beats.show: 3. Search AlejandroGarciaO and check the username and the photo.

beats.say: Four. Review my portfolio, my history and my risk level.
beats.show: 4. Review my portfolio, my history and my risk level.

beats.say: Five. Tap Copy, if the feature is available to you.
beats.show: 5. Tap Copy, if the feature is available to you.

beats.say: Six. Enter the amount. The platform minimum is two hundred dollars.
beats.show: 6. Enter the amount. The platform minimum is $200.

beats.say: Seven. Adjust the Copy Stop-Loss. The default is forty percent. For a long-term strategy like mine, I set it to five percent, so a temporary drop doesn't close the copy.
beats.show: 7. Copy Stop-Loss: the default is 40%. For the long term, I set it to 5%, so a temporary drop doesn't close the copy.

beats.say: Eight. Review the summary, and confirm only when you understand how the positions will open and how much you can lose.
beats.show: 8. Review the summary and confirm only when you understand how the positions will open and how much you can lose.

beats.say: Before you confirm, pause for a second. Review the portfolio, the history and the risk. Understand how the positions will open. And accept how much you can lose: your capital is at risk.
If you want to know my strategy, review my profile on eToro.
